works.headline: The Young Man's Best Works
works.blurb: These projects share one way of working. Start with the people, understand the problem, then work backwards to the experience. They range from digital products and services to visual systems, and each one is a different attempt to make things work better.
works.pageIntro: Three disciplines, one designer with plenty to say. Pick a section below to read the story behind each project, from the big ideas to the small details.

workCategories.name: UI/UX Design
workCategories.blurb: Digital products and services, designed from the person under pressure backwards to the interface. This is where most of the work happens.

workCategories.name: Motion Graphics
workCategories.blurb: Movement, timing and story, from short edits to animated sequences that give a brand or an idea some momentum.

workCategories.name: Graphic Design
workCategories.blurb: Visual identity, layout and type. It's the quieter, flatter side of design, but a lot of the digital work leans on it.
